Details 
 Capital hat is a dependable ranch hat built for everyday wear with clean western style and a comfortable trucker fit. Designed as a breathable country hat, the Capital features a structured front with a classic logo and a mesh back that keeps this western hat cool and comfortable all day. Whether you are working outside, traveling, or heading into town, this ranch hat is made to handle daily wear with ease.
 The traditional trucker design gives this country hat a lightweight feel while still holding its shape through regular use. The adjustable snapback closure provides a secure fit, making this western hat a great choice for long days at the barn, on the road, or outdoors in warm weather. Durable construction and breathable comfort make the Capital a reliable option for any season.
 With its simple western look, this ranch hat pairs easily with your favorite Kimes Ranch jeans, tees, hoodies, and button downs. Built for work, outdoors, and everyday life, the Capital delivers classic ranch style with the comfort and durability you expect from Kimes Ranch.
 Fabric: Polyester Tactile
 Fit: Adjustable Snapback | Mid-Profile | Curved Bill
 Details: Embroidered Logo
